subject.title: fix(acp): preserve structured exec approval metadata

question: When a structured exec approval carries a non-empty `toolCallId` that matches no recorded tool call, should ACP relay it to the sole pending prompt for that session or fail closed?
rationale: The new test documents the contributor's chosen compatibility behavior, but a test cannot establish the intended security-boundary policy; early event ordering favors fallback, while authoritative identifier semantics favor dropping the event.

options.title: Preserve sole-pending fallback
options.body: Match by tool-call identifier first, then relay only when exactly one prompt is pending for the session, preserving early-event compatibility without crossing between concurrent prompts.

options.title: Require identifier match
options.body: Whenever a structured event supplies a tool-call identifier, drop or defer the relay unless that identifier matches a pending tool call, trading compatibility for stricter identity semantics.

recommendation.title: Preserve sole-pending fallback
recommendation.body: Match by tool-call identifier first, then relay only when exactly one prompt is pending for the session, preserving early-event compatibility without crossing between concurrent prompts.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ACP exec approval relay contract and are best positioned to confirm its intended compatibility and security semantics.
